title: Expectation under a biased sign distribution
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$ and let $g$ be a real-valued function on the two signs. Under the sign distribution that assigns probability $1-p$ to $1$ and probability $p$ to $-1$, its expectation is $(1-p)g(1)+pg(-1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on the two signs
